title: session_bundle member: a single record of ui_action_log.jsonl (D1)
description: One line per user/strategy action (session-bundle contract in design document 2: includes the timestamp, selector, page URL and the accessibility information of the triggering element). Raw facts only, no inference (D3).

action_id.description: Action ID unique within the session, used by the page_state index and action_decision_log for association

action_type.description: Action type (e.g. click, fill, navigate; the value table is frozen by the Stage 1 decision record)

page_url.description: URL of the page the action occurred on

element_accessibility.description: Raw snapshot of the triggering element's accessibility information (e.g. role, name)

value.description: Optional: input value carried by the action (input/change-type actions; needed by D16 replay re-fill). Values that hit the secret set are replaced with a redacted placeholder per D18. (Approved addition in decision record 002 §7.1)
